items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...was it "Killer Joe" with the bop phrases in there... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, that number - that particular number - was John Bartee original form.

ctx.x: Okay, because later on it became "No Noise" - Part I & II, same melody and everything. What inspired "No Noise", was that - was it "Killer Joe" with the bop phrases in there or was it something else?
Well, that number - that particular number - was John Bartee original form.
